product.title: Oahu: 60 Min Royal Crown Helicopter Tour - Doors Off or On

description.text: This helicopter tour flies over Oahu past Diamond Head, Sacred Falls, the Dole Plantation, and Pearl Harbor. The flight lasts about an hour, with a choice of doors on or doors off. Several departure times are offered from Honolulu. Passengers pick the time and whether the doors stay on or come off for the aerial pass over Diamond Head, Sacred Falls, the Dole Plantation, and Pearl Harbor. Doors-on and doors-off choices are both offered, along with more than one Honolulu departure time for the hour in the air.
